summary: Validated new Alert History log panel and regression of prior alert/scanner features. All flows work end-to-end: history-toggle opens the slide-over, empty state shows initially, arming threshold 50 on 1s produces multiple crossings within ~10s, each rendered as history-item-<i> with time (fmtClock HH:MM:SS), SYMBOL/USDT, 'crossed ≥ 50 · 1s', trade count, and % change; history-badge on toggle button reflects count (observed 4). history-clear empties list (empty state returns). history-close and clicking dark overlay both close the panel. Regression: search-input (BTC filter), timeframe switch (5m), sort (change_desc), mute-toggle, only-alerts-toggle all functional.
critical_code_review_comments: Scanner.jsx is ~500 lines and starting to grow; consider extracting AlertHistoryPanel into its own component along with the alerts control cluster to keep the page focused.
history-badge shows raw count; may consider capping display (e.g., 99+) when list approaches 300 cap for aesthetics.
Overlay div does not carry a dedicated data-testid; tests must rely on structural selector. Consider adding data-testid='history-overlay' for robustness.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Alert History (iteration_3) validated end-to-end. Threshold 50 on 1s reliably produces crossings within ~10s. If retesting, prefer 1s + 50 (not 1d + 1000 – 1d rows are large but crossings only log for NEW arrivals after arming). History cap is 300; slice([0,300]) confirmed in code.
